content_review.reviewer: Codex exact-taxon source, bilingual, range and image-risk audit
content_review.notes: Every English and Chinese section was compared line by line. Accepted species identity, IUCN scope, numeric claims, map generalization and look-alike image risks were checked against the cited sources. Generalized polygons do not imply continuous occupancy.

conservation_status.note_en: The species-level global category checked on 2026-11-12 is Data Deficient; regional and legal listings may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 已于2026-11-12核对物种级全球等级为数据缺乏；地区和法律名录可能不同。

description.en: The Flamboyant Cuttlefish is a small Indo-Pacific cuttlefish that often walks over the seafloor on its arms and fin lobes. Normally mottled for camouflage, it can pulse vivid yellow, white, purple and dark warning-like patterns.
description.zh: 火焰乌贼是小型印度—太平洋乌贼，常用腕和鳍叶在海床上“行走”。平时以斑驳颜色伪装，也能脉动展示鲜黄、白、紫和深色的警戒式图案。

anatomy.en: The mantle is roughly 6–8 cm long in adults. A reduced internal cuttlebone limits buoyancy, broad arms surround the mouth, two feeding tentacles shoot forward, and chromatophore organs change visible color within moments.
anatomy.zh: 成体外套膜长约6–8厘米。缩小的内骨限制浮力，宽大的腕围绕口部，两条捕食触腕可向前射出，色素胞器官能在瞬间改变可见体色。

ecology_and_behavior.en: It hunts shrimp and small fishes over sand, rubble and reef-associated bottoms. Slow walking and camouflage conserve energy; when prey approaches, the animal rapidly extends its two tentacles to seize it.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 它在沙地、碎石和礁区底部捕食虾及小鱼。缓慢行走和伪装可节省能量；猎物靠近时，它迅速弹出两条触腕抓取。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Recorded in the tropical western Pacific and eastern Indian Ocean, including Indonesia, the Philippines, Papua New Guinea and northern Australia. It lives on shallow sand, rubble, mud and reef-adjacent bottoms rather than across every enclosed area.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 记录分布于热带西太平洋和东印度洋，包括印度尼西亚、菲律宾、巴布亚新几内亚及澳大利亚北部。它生活在浅海沙、碎石、泥和礁缘底部，并非地图圈内处处连续分布。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Males transfer spermatophores to females, which place individual eggs in protected crevices. In managed care, eggs develop for several weeks before hatching into miniature hunters; adults have a short cephalopod life cycle and provide no post-hatching care.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 雄体把精荚传给雌体，雌体把单个卵放入受保护缝隙。在人工照护中，卵发育数周后孵出微型捕食者；成体生命周期较短，孵化后不再照护。

detail.en: Muscular pigment organs create rapidly moving camouflage and high-contrast displays.
detail.zh: 肌肉控制的色素器官形成快速变化的伪装和高对比展示。

detail.en: Arms and muscular fin lobes support controlled movement despite limited buoyancy.
detail.zh: 腕和肌肉发达的鳍叶在浮力有限时支撑可控移动。

detail.en: Two elongated tentacles shoot from the arm crown to seize shrimp or fish at close range.
detail.zh: 两条延长触腕从腕冠射出，在近距离抓住虾或鱼。

ecological_role.en: It is a small benthic predator linking crustaceans and fishes with larger reef and seafloor predators. Its eggs and hatchlings also contribute to shallow tropical food webs.
ecological_role.zh: 它是小型底栖捕食者，把甲壳动物和鱼类与更大型礁区及海床捕食者联系起来；其卵和幼体也参与浅海热带食物网。

threats.en: The species is Data Deficient, so population trend is unknown. Coastal habitat degradation, pollution, destructive fishing and untracked collection for aquariums may affect local populations.
threats.zh: 该物种为数据缺乏，种群趋势未知。沿海生境退化、污染、破坏性捕鱼和缺乏记录的水族贸易捕捉可能影响局地种群。

actions.en: Protect shallow benthic habitat, document exact locality and depth, avoid destructive collection, and expand population and life-history monitoring before assuming the species is secure.
actions.zh: 应保护浅海底栖生境，记录精确地点和水深，避免破坏性捕捉，并扩大种群及生活史监测，不能因缺少数据就假定安全。

key_features.en: A very small broad-armed cuttlefish that often rests or walks on the bottom, with raised papillae and pulsing yellow-white-purple patches. A thin fin runs along the mantle and the body is not shaped like a nudibranch.
key_features.zh: 体形很小、腕宽，常伏在或行走于海底，具有凸起皮肤乳突及脉动黄白紫色斑。外套膜边缘有窄鳍，身体并非海蛞蝓形。

similar_species.en: Painted or broadclub cuttlefishes can show strong colors but are larger and differently proportioned. Exact images should show a compact Ascarosepion body, characteristic walking posture and verified western Indo-Pacific locality.
similar_species.zh: 彩乌贼或宽腕乌贼也会展示强烈颜色，但体形更大、比例不同。准确照片应显示紧凑的焰乌贼属体形、典型行走姿态及可信西印度—太平洋地点。

communication_and_senses.en: Large camera-type eyes judge distance and polarization, while suckers taste and touch prey. Skin pattern changes communicate condition and help conceal the animal from both prey and predators.
communication_and_senses.zh: 大型照相机式眼睛判断距离和偏振光，吸盘则触摸并尝味猎物；皮肤花纹变化既传递状态，也帮助躲避猎物和捕食者。

seasonal_calendar.en: A single universal breeding season is not established across its tropical range. Local temperature and food affect egg development, and captive schedules should not be projected directly onto wild populations.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 在其热带分布区内尚未确定统一繁殖季。局地温度和食物会影响卵发育，圈养时间表不能直接套用于野外种群。

relationship_with_humans.en: Its colors make it popular with divers and aquariums, but animals should not be touched or collected. The accepted name Ascarosepion pfefferi replaces the widely used older combination Metasepia pfefferi.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 它因鲜艳体色受到潜水者和水族馆关注，但不应触摸或捕捉。当前接受名为Ascarosepion pfefferi，取代广泛使用的旧组合Metasepia pfefferi。

evolution.en: Flamboyant Cuttlefish belongs to genus Ascarosepion, family Sepiidae, order Sepiida. This record uses the accepted species-level binomial Ascarosepion pfefferi; facts and images are not transferred from close relatives.
evolution.zh: 火焰乌贼归入焰乌贼属、乌贼科、乌贼目。本条目采用接受的物种级二名法Ascarosepion pfefferi；不会从近缘种移用事实或图片。

field_signs.en: Search slowly over sand-rubble transitions for a tiny animal stepping on arm tips. Record neutral and display colors, mantle shape, depth and locality; color alone is not enough for species identification.
field_signs.zh: 可在沙地—碎石过渡带缓慢寻找用腕尖迈步的小型个体。应记录平静和展示体色、外套膜形状、水深与地点；仅凭颜色不能鉴定到种。

text.en: It often walks more than it swims because its cuttlebone provides limited buoyancy.
text.zh: 由于内骨提供的浮力有限，它常常行走多于游泳。

text.en: Its bright display is produced by living pigment organs rather than a fixed shell color.
text.zh: 鲜艳展示来自活体色素器官，并非固定壳色。

text.en: Many sources still use its older scientific combination Metasepia pfefferi.
text.zh: 许多资料仍使用旧学名组合Metasepia pfefferi。

content.en: Chromatophores expand and contract under neural control, while structural reflector cells alter brightness. Together they create moving patterns far faster than ordinary pigment growth.
content.zh: 色素胞在神经控制下扩张和收缩，结构反光细胞则改变亮度；二者共同形成远快于普通色素生长的动态图案。

habitat.text_en: Recorded in the tropical western Pacific and eastern Indian Ocean, including Indonesia, the Philippines, Papua New Guinea and northern Australia. It lives on shallow sand, rubble, mud and reef-adjacent bottoms rather than across every enclosed area.
habitat.text_zh: 记录分布于热带西太平洋和东印度洋，包括印度尼西亚、菲律宾、巴布亚新几内亚及澳大利亚北部。它生活在浅海沙、碎石、泥和礁缘底部，并非地图圈内处处连续分布。

range_review.comparison_en: This new record has no previous geometry. The displayed nonrectangular polygons conservatively generalize the cited institutional distribution evidence for readable map display; boundaries are approximate and never imply continuous occupancy.
range_review.comparison_zh: 这是没有旧几何的新记录。显示的非矩形多边形依据所引机构分布证据作保守概化，以便地图清晰呈现；边界为近似范围，绝不表示圈内连续分布。
